div.p: Bathory (old, Re-Sacralising Satan) - Satanic, Primal, Raw
Bathory (later, Sacralising Paganism) - Pagan, Epic, Uplifting
Celtic Frost (old, Re-Sacralising Occult) - Raw, Sophisticated, Morbid

div.p: Core-tag is the genre defining, unalterable tag, which for black metal is "Re-sacralising" and death metal is "De-sacralising". The Core-Tag is only visible to The Elite, and they ignore everything that doesn't have it as "posing". Black Metal elite are looking for Re-Sacralising, Death Metal elite for De-Sacralising.
An act that meets core-tag while residing outside of the desired sonic architecture can be for example called "Blackened".

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding-top: 525px; margin-left: 232px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0px; text-align: left;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: nowrap;

div.div:
Resonance Tags
Every GameEntity has a resonance tag, be they a place to a person or a track.
This tag is basically the overall vibe or feeling the thing resonates to its surroundings.
Mood Tags
Every actor class object has a mood tag, which simply reflects their current mood.
This is why you need to keep your band members in certain frame of mind.
Conviction Tags
This tag reflects the actors conviction, and is always available for proselytizing.

box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0px; text-align: left;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: nowrap;

div.div:
Aspects
Besides tags, aspects are another gate to keep for purists. Aspects are objects that are used between the tag and the actor,
usually in the form of rock-instruments. Besides instruments or studio equipment, aspects can be thoughts or societal stances.
Elitists and Posers are suspicious about new aspects that are not yet in their approved aspect lists. Elitists have a petAspect
that they are actively looking for in music.
Aspects are something that the scene tends to take for granted until they are challenged, so aspects can also reflect the status
quo where it influences people without them realizing it. At the beginning of the game, TRUE is dominated by rock instruments
and expects attitudes to align with societal norms where it isn't distinctly guided to other directions by tags.

Black Metal - Re-sacralising
Death Metal, Punk, Trash - De-sacralising
Blues, Doom Metal, NWOBHM - Sacralising

div.p: Novelty is the reason why illegitimate and impure aspects are introduced into the scene. When an aspect is first introduced into the scene, it gets a novelty-bonus. The novelty bonus degrades with each new iteration of the aspect in other releases.
